content:
As WhatsApp approaches the official rollout of usernames, the app now lets users save a contact’s username alongside their name and phone number. Here are the details.

Username field for new contacts roll out to select WhatsApp users

Although it is a commonplace feature on most messaging platforms, WhatsApp has only recently begun to move away from relying exclusively on phone numbers for user identification.

Earlier this year, WhatsApp started rolling out a username reservation system to give users a chance to claim their preferred handles and avoid scam impersonations before usernames officially launched.

Then, a few weeks ago, it started activating usernames for select iPhone users.

Now, as spotted by WABetaInfo, the app is starting to roll out support for a username field when users create a new contact. The username field appears between the first and last name fields and the phone number section.

From WaBetaInfo:

WABetaInfo notes that the username field appears to be rolling out to select users on both the beta and stable versions of WhatsApp.

In my testing with the latest stable release, the field appears, but it returns a “This username is not on WhatsApp” message even when the username exists.

That said, this is yet another step toward WhatsApp finally catching up with the competition by adding what many consider a basic feature that has long been missing.
